_comment: Party progression (issue #15). levels: XP to go from level L to L+1 is round(xp_base * xp_growth^(L-1)), up to max. growth: what each level adds per field hero (hp, damage, ink; fractions add up and round down, so 0.5 damage = +1 every other level). Base stats live in data/heroes.json. items: gear. slot: weapon, armor or trinket (consumables are the quick menu's satchel, issue #6). hero: weapon belongs to that hero only. stats: added to the hero (hp, damage, power_rate = gauge refill bonus as a fraction, speed px/s, reach px, guard = fraction of damage blocked, ink, heal = poultice HP). price: Gilt in the Hollowmark shop (sells back for half). shop: false = only found on missions. needs: research node that must be known before the shop stocks it. drops: per-kill chance on missions and the weighted table picked from; items found are kept on success or retreat and lost if the party is wiped out. barracks_xp: XP a day for each field hero on the bench (not in the party), per Barracks level. mission_xp: bonus XP to the party for finishing a mission (missions.json can set its own "xp").

quill_knife.name: Quill-knife
quill_knife.blurb: A pen sharpened past the point of writing. Ash woke up holding it.

steel_nib.name: Steel Nib
steel_nib.blurb: A longer, meaner nib. Signs things permanently.

ravens_quill.name: Raven's Quill
ravens_quill.blurb: Black, glossy and impatient. It wants the next stroke before you finish this one.

contract_cleaver.name: Contract Cleaver
contract_cleaver.blurb: Bran's old cleaver. The handle has his rates carved into it.

notary_axe.name: Notary's Axe
notary_axe.blurb: Used to stamp seals into wax. Now stamps them into Nibblers.

foreclosure.name: Foreclosure
foreclosure.blurb: A two-handed cleaver the size of a door. Bran calls it a negotiating position.

bone_ladle.name: Bone Ladle
bone_ladle.blurb: Gristle won't say whose bone. She will say it stirs well.

copper_ladle.name: Copper Ladle
copper_ladle.blurb: Conducts heat, gossip and, apparently, healing.

cauldron_spoon.name: Cauldron Spoon
cauldron_spoon.blurb: Long enough to stir a soup from across the room. Or to reach a patient who is running away.

concord_pike.name: Concord Pike
concord_pike.blurb: Standard Concord issue. Daro filed off the serial number and one of the prongs.

tollkeeper_pike.name: Tollkeeper's Pike
tollkeeper_pike.blurb: Made for blocking bridges. Long, heavy, and very persuasive.

breach_lance.name: Breach Lance
breach_lance.blurb: A siege lance cut down to something one reckless person can carry.

padded_coat.name: Padded Coat
padded_coat.blurb: Quilted, patched and warm. Smells faintly of someone else's dog.

ledger_mail.name: Ledger Mail
ledger_mail.blurb: Rings of iron threaded with old ledger pages. Teeth catch on the sums.

inkskin_vest.name: Inkskin Vest
inkskin_vest.blurb: A vest of written leather. The words knit shut where something bites.

bent_nib.name: Bent Nib
bent_nib.blurb: A pen nib bent into a ring. Pointy on the inside too, so you stay alert.

lucky_button.name: Lucky Button
lucky_button.blurb: Off a coat that survived the Blank. The coat's owner did not, which raises questions.

running_boots.name: Courier's Laces
running_boots.blurb: Laces from a courier's boots. Your feet get the idea.

blotter_charm.name: Blotter Charm
blotter_charm.blurb: A square of blotting paper in a locket. Soaks up spilt Ink for later.

shop_blurb: Odds, ends and sharp things, sold off a cart that is never in the same place twice.
